brief:
Hamas accused the Israeli army of being "a partner and accomplice" with settlers in their West Bank attacks, Shehab Wire reported. The movement rejected claims by Israeli Defense Minister Itamar Ben-Gvir that the military is unable to contain settler violence, describing such statements as "deception and lies" contradicted by ground realities.

Hamas contends that Israeli forces actively facilitate or enable attacks by settlers rather than restraining them, a charge consistent with longstanding Palestinian allegations of coordinated violence in the occupied territory.

title: Hamas accuses Israeli military of complicity in settler attacks
